title: Rezyume va o‘zini taqdim etish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz professional inglizcha rezyume (CV) yoza olasiz: to‘g‘ri bo‘limlar va so‘z boyligi, yutuqlarni action verbs va raqamlar bilan ifodalash, uch jumlalik profile summary, sanalar va lavozim nomlarining bir xil formati, professional bio va LinkedIn profili, ATS tizimlari uchun kalit so‘zlar bilan moslashtirish va rezyumeni ishonch bilan jo‘natish.
homework_uz: O‘zingizning CV summary’ingizni (3 jumla) va 5 ta achievement line yozing: har birida action verb + raqam yoki natija bo‘lsin; avvalgi zaif qatorlaringizni kuchli qatorlarga aylantiring; bitta haqiqiy ish e’loniga mos CV versiyasini tayyorlab, uni ATS nuqtai nazaridan kalit so‘zlarga tekshiring; yozganlaringizni darsdagi namunalar bilan solishtirib, xatolarini to‘g‘rilang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: summary 3 jumladan oshmasin, har achievement line’da aniq raqam bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: P1-03 Ish joyida hamkasblar bilan muloqot.

scenes.title: Rezyumega xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda ish suhbatini o‘rgandik. Bugun suhbatgacha bo‘lgan birinchi qadam — rezyume. Kuchli mutaxassislar ko‘pincha zaif rezyume tufayli suhbatga ham taklif olmaydi. Dars oxirida siz professional CV va qisqa bio yozasiz: to‘g‘ri bo‘limlar, kuchli fe’llar, raqamli yutuqlar va ish e’loniga moslashtirish.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last time we covered the interview. Today, the first step — the resume. Many strong candidates never reach the interview because of a weak CV. By the end you will write a professional CV and bio: sections, strong verbs, quantified wins, and tailoring to each ad.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda ish suhbatini o‘rgandik. Bugun suhbatgacha bo‘lgan birinchi qadam — rezyume. Kuchli nomzodlar zaif rezyume tufayli suhbatga taklif olmaydi. Dars oxirida siz professional CV va qisqa bio yozasiz: bo‘limlar, kuchli fe’llar, raqamli yutuqlar, moslashtirish.

scenes.title: Resume nima, CV nima va ATS nima?

examples.t: Please send your CV and cover letter.

scenes.say_native: Avvalo so‘zlarni aniqlab olaylik. AQShda resume — 1–2 sahifalik qisqa hujjat; Yevropada ko‘pincha CV deyiladi. Ko‘p ish beruvchilar birinchi o‘qishni dasturga topshiradi — ATS rezyumeni kalit so‘zlar bo‘yicha skanerlab, mos kelmaganini avtomatik rad etadi. Rezyume demak ham odam, ham mashina uchun yoziladi.
scenes.say: First, the words. In the US a resume is one to two pages; in Europe it is often called a CV. Most employers run a first pass through software — an ATS scans for keywords and auto-rejects mismatches. So your resume is written for a human and a machine.
scenes.say_uz: Avval so‘zlar. AQShda resume — 1–2 sahifalik hujjat; Yevropada CV deyiladi. Ko‘p ish beruvchilar birinchi o‘qishni dasturga topshiradi — ATS kalit so‘zlar bo‘yicha tekshiradi. Demak, rezyume odam ham, mashina ham o‘qishi uchun yoziladi.

scenes.title: CV’ning besh asosiy bo‘limi
scenes.say_native: Skeletni o‘zlashtiring. Birinchi: contact information — ism, professional email, telefon, LinkedIn havolasi. Ikkinchi: profile summary — uch jumlalik taqdimot. Uchinchi: experience — oxirgi ish birinchi: lavozim, kompaniya, sana, yutuqlar. To‘rtinchi: education. Beshinchi: skills. Bu besh bo‘lim har inglizcha rezyumeda bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Learn the skeleton. One: contact information — name, professional email, phone, LinkedIn link. Two: a three-sentence profile summary. Three: experience, latest first — title, company, dates, achievements. Four: education. Five: skills. These five sections belong to every English-language resume.
scenes.say_uz: Skeletni o‘zlashtiring. Bir: contact information — ism, professional email, telefon, LinkedIn. Ikki: profile summary — uch jumlalik taqdimot. Uch: experience — oxirgi ish birinchi: lavozim, kompaniya, sana, yutuqlar. To‘rt: education. Besh: skills. Bu besh bo‘lim har inglizcha rezyumeda bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Profile summary: uch jumlalik formula

examples.t: Formula: who you are → proof → what you offer.
examples.uz: Formula: kim siz → dalil → nima berasiz.

scenes.say_native: Profile summary — rezyumening eng yuqorisidagi uch jumla. Birinchi jumla: kasbingiz va tajriba yilingiz. Ikkinchi: eng katta yutug‘ingiz, albatta raqam bilan. Uchinchi: shu kompaniyaga nima taklif qilishingiz. Uchala jumla birga yetmish so‘zdan oshmasin. Vazifasi — HR’ni hujjatni oxirigacha o‘qishga undash.
scenes.say: The profile summary is the three lines at the top of your CV. One: who you are — role and years. Two: your biggest win, with a number. Three: what you bring to this company. Seventy words maximum. Its only job is to make HR keep reading.
scenes.say_uz: Profile summary — rezyumening eng tepasidagi uch jumla. Birinchi: kasbingiz va tajriba yilingiz. Ikkinchi: eng katta yutug‘ingiz, albatta raqam bilan. Uchinchi: shu kompaniyaga nima taklif qilishingiz. Yetmish so‘zdan oshmasin. Vazifasi — HR’ni hujjatni o‘qishga undash.

scenes.title: Namuna: Jasurning summary’si
scenes.say_native: Namuna summary’ni tinglang. Jasur birinchi jumlada kimligini aytadi: to‘rt yillik tajribaga ega marketing ijrochisi. Ikkinchi jumlada yutug‘ini raqam bilan beradi: jalb qilish o‘ttiz foizga oshgan. Uchinchi jumlada lavozimga nima taklif qilishini aytadi: ma’lumotlarga asoslangan yondashuv va jamoalar bilan hamkorlik. Uch jumla, yetmish so‘z.
scenes.say: Digital marketing executive with four years of experience across social media and email campaigns. Increased online engagement by thirty percent last year through data-driven content strategy. Offer cross-functional collaboration and measurable campaign results.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt yillik tajribaga ega digital marketing ijrochisi, ijtimoiy tarmoqlar va email kampaniyalar bo‘yicha. Ma’lumotlarga asoslangan kontent orqali o‘tgan yili jalb qilishni o‘ttiz foizga oshirdim. Jamoalar bilan hamkorlik va o‘lchanadigan natijalarni taklif qilaman.

scenes.title: Summary’ni o‘zingiz yozing
board: 3 jumla: kim siz → yutuq (raqam) → nima berasiz
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz uch jumla yozing. Birinchi jumlada kasbingiz va tajribangiz, ikkinchisida raqamli yutug‘ingiz, uchinchisida shu lavozimga nima berishingiz. Yetmish so‘zdan oshirmang va fe’llarni kuchli tanlang. Ovoz chiqarib o‘qib ko‘ring — silliq aytilmasa, HR ham silliq o‘qimaydi.
scenes.say: Write yours. One: your role and experience. Two: your quantified win. Three: what you bring here. Under seventy words, strong verbs. Read it aloud — if it does not flow for your ear, it will not flow for HR either.
scenes.say_uz: Endi uch jumla yozing. Birinchi: kasbingiz va tajribangiz; ikkinchi: raqamli yutug‘ingiz; uchinchi: shu lavozimga nima berishingiz. Yetmish so‘zdan oshirmang, fe’llarni kuchli tanlang. Ovoz chiqarib o‘qib ko‘ring — HR’ga ham silliq eshitilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Action verbs: yutuqni kuchli fe’l bilan boshlang
board: Har qator fe’l bilan boshlansin, 'I' siz

examples.t: Managed a team of five and launched three campaigns.
examples.uz: Besh kishilik jamoani boshqardim va uch kampaniyani ishga tushirdim.

scenes.say_native: Har achievement qatorini harakat fe’li bilan boshlang — I so‘zisiz. Yod oling: led, managed, delivered, launched, increased, reduced, improved, achieved, built, negotiated, implemented, designed. 'I got', 'I did', 'I was responsible for' — zaif. Fe’lni oldinga qo‘ying. Har qatorni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing — silliq chiqadi.
scenes.say: Start every achievement bullet with an action verb — drop the word I. Memorise: led, managed, delivered, launched, increased, reduced, improved, achieved, built, negotiated, implemented, designed. I got, I did, I was responsible for — all weak. Put the verb at the front.
scenes.say_uz: Har qatorni harakat fe’li bilan boshlang — I so‘zisiz. Yod oling: led, managed, delivered, launched, increased, reduced, improved, achieved, built, negotiated, implemented, designed. I got, I did, I was responsible for — zaif. Fe’lni oldinga qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Yutuqni raqamlashtiring

examples.t: Reduced response time from 4 hours to 40 minutes.

scenes.say_native: Kuchli yutuq qatori uchta elementdan iborat: fe’l, vazifa, o‘lchanadigan natija. Natijani to‘rt usulda raqamlashtiring: foiz — o‘ttiz foiz o‘sish; pul — qirq ming dollar tejash; son — besh kishilik jamoa; vaqt — uch haftada. Raqamli qator suhbat stoliga chiqadi, raqamsizi esa o‘chiladi.
scenes.say: A strong bullet has three parts: verb, task, measurable result. Quantify four ways: a percentage — up thirty percent; money — saved forty thousand dollars; a count — a team of five; time — delivered in three weeks. A bullet with a number gets discussed at the table.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli yutuq qatori uchta elementdan iborat: fe’l, vazifa, o‘lchanadigan natija. To‘rt usul: foiz — o‘ttiz foiz o‘sish; pul — qirq ming dollar; son — besh kishilik jamoa; vaqt — uch haftada. Raqamli qator suhbatga chiqadi, raqamsizi o‘chiladi.

scenes.title: Namuna: Jasurning 5 ta achievement line’i
scenes.say_native: Jasurning beshta qatorini eshiting. Bir: jalb qilishni o‘ttiz foizga oshirdi. Ikki: to‘rt kishilik jamoani boshqardi. Uch: kampaniya xarajatlarini o‘n sakkiz foizga qisqartirdi. To‘rt: yangi CRM’ni olti haftada ishga tushirdi. Besh: email obunachilarini o‘n ikki mingga yetkazdi. Har qatorda fe’l, vazifa va raqam bor.
scenes.say: Lifted online engagement by thirty percent through data-driven content. Managed a cross-functional team of four across two time zones. Cut campaign costs by eighteen percent without reducing reach. Launched the new CRM in six weeks, two weeks early. Grew the newsletter from four thousand to twelve thousand.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’lumotlarga asoslangan kontent orqali jalb qilishni o‘ttiz foizga oshirdim. Ikki vaqt zonasidagi to‘rt kishilik jamoani boshqardim. Qamrovni kamaytirmasdan xarajatni o‘n sakkiz foizga qisqartirdim. CRM’ni reja muddatidan ikki hafta oldin — olti haftada ishga tushirdim. Obunachilarni to‘rt mingdan o‘n ikki mingga o‘stirdim.

scenes.title: Zaif qatorni kuchli qatorga aylantiring
scenes.say_native: Uchta zaif qatorni kuchli qatorga aylantiring. 'I was responsible for social media' — Led social media for… plus raqam. 'Responsible for emails' — Managed the weekly newsletter for… plus open rate. 'Helped the sales team' — Supported the sales team with… va natija. Fe’lni oldinga qo‘ying, bo‘sh joylarga raqam toping.
scenes.say: Rewrite three weak lines. I was responsible for social media becomes Led social media for … plus a number. Responsible for emails becomes Managed the weekly newsletter for … plus an open rate. Helped the sales team becomes Supported the sales team with … and an outcome. Verb first, numbers filled in.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta zaif qatorni kuchli qatorga aylantiring. I was responsible for social media → Led social media for… plus raqam. Responsible for emails → Managed the weekly newsletter for… plus open rate. Helped the sales team → Supported the sales team with… va natija. Fe’lni oldinga qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Sanalar, shaharlar va lavozim nomlarining formati
board: Lavozim: bozor qabul qilgan inglizcha nom
scenes.say_native: Format bir xil bo‘lsin: sanalarni bitta usulda yozing — March 2022 – Present yoki 03/2022 – Present, aralashmang. Shaharni shahar, vergul, mamlakat ko‘rinishida yozing: Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Lavozim nomlari o‘sha bozorda qabul qilingan rasmiy inglizcha ko‘rinishda bo‘lsin: Marketing Executive, Sales Manager. O‘zbekcha unvonni qavs ichida qo‘shishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: Keep formats uniform. Dates one way only — March 2022 – Present or 03/2022 – Present — never mixed. City, Country: Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Job titles in their recognised English form: Marketing Executive, Sales Manager. You may add the Uzbek title in brackets if it matters.
scenes.say_uz: Format bir xil bo‘lsin: sanalar bitta usulda — March 2022 – Present yoki 03/2022 – Present. Shahar: Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Lavozimlar bozor tan oladigan inglizcha ko‘rinishda: Marketing Executive, Sales Manager. O‘zbekcha unvonni qavsda qo‘shishingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Lavozim nomlarini inglizchaga o‘girish

examples.t: Bosh hisobchi → Chief Accountant / Head of Finance
examples.uz: Bosh hisobchi — Chief Accountant yoki Head of Finance.

scenes.say_native: So‘zma-so‘z tarjima eng keng tarqalgan xato. 'Bosh hisobchi' — Chief Accountant yoki Head of Finance, 'o‘rinbosar' — Deputy Head, 'mutaxassis' — Specialist yoki Officer, 'yetakchi' — Lead yoki Senior. Kompaniya ichidagi unvonni qavsda o‘zbekcha qoldiring; asosiy satr bozor tushunadigan inglizcha nom bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Literal translation is the classic mistake. Bosh hisobchi is Chief Accountant or Head of Finance; o‘rinbosar is Deputy Head; mutaxassis is Specialist or Officer; yetakchi is Lead or Senior. Keep the internal title in brackets, but the headline line must be the market-recognised English title.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zma-so‘z tarjima eng keng tarqalgan xato. Bosh hisobchi — Chief Accountant yoki Head of Finance; o‘rinbosar — Deputy Head; mutaxassis — Specialist; yetakchi — Lead yoki Senior. Ichki unvoningizni qavsda qoldiring, asosiy satr esa bozor tan oladigan inglizcha nom bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Skills bo‘limi: hard va soft ko‘nikmalar
board: Hard skills: Excel, SQL, Python, CRM

examples.t: Hard: SQL, Tableau. Soft: cross-functional communication.
examples.uz: Hard: SQL, Tableau. Soft: jamoalararo muloqot.

scenes.say_native: Skills ikki guruhdan iborat. Hard skills — o‘lchanadigan texnik ko‘nikmalar: Excel, SQL, Python, Figma, CRM. Soft skills — shaxsiy: muloqot, jamoada ishlash, yetakchilik, mas’uliyat. Har guruhdan besh-oltitasini yozing va ish e’lonidagi so‘zlar bilan moslang. Yoniga darajani qo‘shing: advanced, intermediate — ayniqsa dasturlar va tillar uchun.
scenes.say: Skills come in two groups. Hard skills — measurable technical abilities: Excel, SQL, Python, Figma, CRM. Soft skills — personal: communication, teamwork, leadership. Pick five or six from each and align them with the job ad's exact words. Add a level — advanced, intermediate — especially for tools and languages.
scenes.say_uz: Skills ikki guruhdan iborat. Hard skills — texnik: Excel, SQL, Python, Figma, CRM. Soft skills — shaxsiy: muloqot, jamoada ishlash, yetakchilik. Har guruhdan besh-oltitasini yozing va e’lon so‘zlari bilan moslang. Yoniga daraja qo‘shing: advanced, intermediate.

scenes.title: Tillar va dasturlar: darajalarni to‘g‘ri yozing

examples.uz: Ingliz tili: ravon (IELTS 7.5). Rus tili: ona tili.

scenes.say_native: Tillar bo‘limi ko‘pincha chalkashtiriladi. Ona tili — native; yuqori daraja — fluent yoki proficient; o‘rta — intermediate; boshlang‘ich — basic. Uzbek: native. Ingliz tili uchun sertifikat bo‘lsa yozing: English: fluent (IELTS 7.5). Dasturlarga ham daraja qo‘ying: Excel — advanced, Python — intermediate. Raqamli dalil har doim oddiy da’vodan ustun.
scenes.say: The languages section is often fumbled. Native for mother tongue; fluent or proficient for a high level; intermediate for middle; basic for elementary. Uzbek: native. Hold a certificate? Write it: English: fluent (IELTS 7.5). Add levels to software too: Excel — advanced, Python — intermediate. Quantified proof always beats a bare claim.
scenes.say_uz: Tillar bo‘limi ko‘pincha chalkashtiriladi. Ona tili — native; yuqori daraja — fluent; o‘rta — intermediate. Uzbek: native. Sertifikat bo‘lsa: English: fluent (IELTS 7.5). Dasturlarga ham daraja qo‘ying: Excel — advanced, Python — intermediate. Raqamli dalil har doim oddiy da’vodan ustun.

scenes.title: Education va sertifikatlar
scenes.say_native: Education tartibi: daraja, muassasa, shahar, yil — BSc in Marketing, Westminster International University in Tashkent, 2021. Sertifikatlarni alohida satrga yozing: nom, platforma, yil — Google Data Analytics, Coursera, 2024. Tugallanmagan kursni in progress deb yozing, yolg‘on shart emas. GPA faqat 3.5 dan yuqori bo‘lsa yoziladi.
scenes.say: Education order: degree, institution, city, year — BSc in Marketing, Westminster International University in Tashkent, 2021. Certificates on their own lines: name, platform, year — Google Data Analytics, Coursera, 2024. An unfinished course is written in progress — never faked. Mention GPA only above 3.5.
scenes.say_uz: Education tartibi: daraja, muassasa, shahar, yil — BSc in Marketing, Westminster International University in Tashkent, 2021. Sertifikatlarni alohida satrga yozing: nom, platforma, yil — Coursera, 2024. Tugallanmagan kurs — in progress. GPA faqat 3.5 dan yuqori bo‘lsa yoziladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: CV ko‘rib chiqish sessiyasi
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — rezyume ko‘rib chiqish uchrashuvi. Jasur rezyumeni kariyer maslahatchisiga ko‘rsatmoqda. Maslahatchi uch kamchilikni topadi: summary juda uzun, sanalar formati aralash, achievement qatorlarida raqam yo‘q. Jasur qayta yozib ko‘rsatadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — savollar keyin beriladi.
scenes.say: Advisor: Your summary is four lines — cut it to three and open with your role. Jasur: Like this? 'Digital marketing executive with four years of experience.' Advisor: Better. Now dates — one says March 2022, another 03/2022. Jasur: I'll unify to Month Year. Advisor: And this bullet has no number. Jasur: 'Led social media, growing engagement thirty percent.' Advisor: Now it works. One page, keywords from the ad, PDF only.
scenes.say_uz: Maslahatchi: Summary to‘rt qator — uchga qisqartiring va lavozimdan boshlang. Jasur: Shundaymi? 'Digital marketing executive with four years of experience.' Maslahatchi: Yaxshi. Endi sanalar — bittasi March 2022, boshqasi 03/2022. Jasur: Month Year formatiga birlashtiraman. Maslahatchi: Va bu qatorda raqam yo‘q. Jasur: 'Led social media, growing engagement thirty percent.' Maslahatchi: Endi bo‘ladi. Bir sahifa, e’lon kalit so‘zlari, faqat PDF.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
board: 2 Qaysi ikki sana formati aralashgan edi?
3 'Managed social media' qatori nimasi bilan zaif?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savolga javob bering. Bir: summary necha qatorga qisqartirilishi kerak? Ikki: qaysi ikki sana formati aralash edi? Uch: 'Managed social media' qatori nimasi bilan zaif edi? To‘rt: maslahatchining yakuniy talablari qanday? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting — keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Answer four questions. One: to how many lines should the summary be cut? Two: which two date formats were mixed? Three: what was wrong with the 'Managed social media' bullet? Four: what final requirements did the advisor set? Answers in your head — we check next.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: summary necha qatorga qisqartirilishi kerak? Ikki: qaysi ikki sana formati aralash edi? Uch: 'Managed social media' nimasi bilan zaif edi? To‘rt: maslahatchi qanday yakuniy talab qo‘ydi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
board: 4. Bir sahifa + kalit so‘zlar + faqat PDF
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: summary to‘rt qatordan uchga qisqartirildi va lavozimdan boshlandi. Ikki: March 2022 va 03/2022 aralashgan edi — Month Year ga birlashtirildi. Uch: 'Managed social media' raqamsiz edi — o‘ttiz foiz o‘sish qo‘shildi. To‘rt: maslahatchi uch talab qo‘ydi — bir sahifa, e’lon kalit so‘zlari, faqat PDF.
scenes.say: Answers. One: cut from four lines to three, opening with the role. Two: March 2022 and 03/2022 were mixed — unified to Month Year. Three: 'Managed social media' had no number — thirty percent growth was added. Four: one page, ad keywords, PDF only.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: to‘rt qatordan uchga tushirildi, lavozimdan boshlandi. Ikki: March 2022 va 03/2022 aralashgan edi — birlashtirildi. Uch: raqamsiz edi — o‘ttiz foiz qo‘shildi. To‘rt: bir sahifa, e’lon kalit so‘zlari, faqat PDF.

scenes.title: Rezyumedagi 8 ta eng keng tarqalgan xato
scenes.say_native: Sakkita xato. Bir: 'objective' emas, summary yozing. Ikki: uzun paragraflar o‘rniga bullet. Uch: imlo xatolarini tekshirmasdan yubormang. To‘rt: yosh, oilaviy holat, foto — inglizcha rezyumeda shart emas. Besh: 'references upon request' keraksiz. Oltinchi: har e’lon uchun CV moslang. Yettinchi: vazifani yutuq qilib ko‘rsatmang. Sakkizinchi: maksimum ikki sahifa.
scenes.say: Eight mistakes. One: write a summary, not a generic objective. Two: bullets, not prose. Three: never send unproofed. Four: age, marital status, photo don't belong. Five: 'references upon request' is filler. Six: tailor every CV to the ad. Seven: duties are not achievements. Eight: two pages maximum.
scenes.say_uz: Sakkita xato. Bir: objective emas, summary. Ikki: proza emas, bullet. Uch: imlo xatolarini tekshiring. To‘rt: yosh, oila, foto kerak emas. Besh: 'references upon request' ortiqcha. Oltinchi: har e’lon uchun moslang. Yettinchi: vazifani yutuq qilmang. Sakkizinchi: ikki sahifa maksimum.

scenes.title: ATS uchun kalit so‘zlar: e’lon tahlili

examples.t: Job ad keywords → same words in your CV.
examples.uz: E’londagi kalit so‘zlar → CV’da aynan shu so‘zlar.

scenes.say_native: ATS kalit so‘zlarni qidiradi, sinonimlarni emas. E’lonni o‘qib o‘n-o‘n besh kalit so‘z ajrating: dasturlar, texnologiyalar, rol so‘zlari. E’londa 'stakeholder management' yozilgan bo‘lsa, aynan 'stakeholder management' deb yozing, parafraz emas. Kalit so‘zlar summary, skills va experience qismlariga tabiiy tarqalsin — sun’iy to‘ldirmang.
scenes.say: The ATS looks for keywords, not synonyms. Extract ten to fifteen: tools, technologies, role words. If the ad says 'stakeholder management', write exactly that — never a paraphrase. Spread keywords naturally across summary, skills and experience — never stuff them artificially.
scenes.say_uz: ATS kalit so‘zlarni qidiradi, sinonimni emas. E’londan o‘n-o‘n besh kalit so‘z ajrating: dasturlar, rol so‘zlari. E’londa 'stakeholder management' yozilgan bo‘lsa, aynan shu so‘z bilan yozing. Kalit so‘zlar summary, skills va experience qismlariga tabiiy tarqalsin.

scenes.title: Employment gap va career change: qanday yozish
board: Career change: bir xil ko‘nikmalarni urg‘ulang

examples.t: Career break for family care; completed Google Analytics course.
examples.uz: Oilaviy sabab bilan uzilish; Google Analytics kursini tugatdim.

scenes.say_native: Uzilishni yashirmang — bir qatorda halol sababini yozing: Career break — family care, 2023 yoki Sabbatical — health recovery. Eng muhimi: o‘sha davrda nima qilganingizni ko‘rsating — kurs, frilans, ko‘ngilli ish. Kasb o‘zgartirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, ikki sohadagi bir xil ko‘nikmalarni urg‘ulang.
scenes.say: Never hide a gap — one honest line: Career break — family care, 2023, or Sabbatical — health recovery. Then show what you did: a course, freelance, volunteering. If switching careers, highlight the skills both fields share.
scenes.say_uz: Uzilishni yashirmang — bir qatorda halol sabab: Career break — family care, 2023 yoki Sabbatical. Keyin o‘sha davrda nima qilganingizni ko‘rsating — kurs, frilans. Kasb o‘zgartirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, ikki sohadagi bir xil ko‘nikmalarni urg‘ulang.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: Bio yozish maslahati
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — professional bio yozish maslahati. Nilufar conference uchun to‘rt jumlalik bio yozmoqchi. Maslahatchi bioning qoidalarini tushuntiradi: uchinchi shaxs, hozirgi zamon. Nilufar o‘z biosini ovoz chiqarib o‘qiydi, maslahatchi ikkita tuzatish beradi. Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Advisor: A bio is four sentences, third person, present tense. Who you are, your signature win, what you do now, one human detail. Nilufar: 'Nilufar Karimova is a data analyst with five years in fintech. She built a churn model that saved two hundred thousand dollars. She leads the analytics guild at Uzum Bank. She mentors juniors on weekends.' Advisor: Two fixes — drop 'very', and replace 'huge impact' with your number. Nilufar: Done.
scenes.say_uz: Maslahatchi: Bio — to‘rt jumla, uchinchi shaxs, hozirgi zamon. Kimligingiz, imzo yutug‘ingiz, hozir nima qilayotganingiz, bitta insoniy detal. Nilufar: 'Nilufar Karimova is a data analyst with five years in fintech. She built a churn model that saved two hundred thousand dollars. She leads the analytics guild at Uzum Bank. She mentors juniors on weekends.' Maslahatchi: Ikkita tuzatish — 'very'ni olib tashlang va 'huge impact'ni raqamingiz bilan almashtiring. Nilufar: Tayyor.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: bio necha jumlada yoziladi? Ikki: bio qaysi grammatik shaxsdan yoziladi? Uch: Nilufar qaysi yutug‘ini aytdi va natijasi nima edi? To‘rt: maslahatchi qanday ikki tuzatish berdi? Javoblarni ichingizda takrorlang — keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz. Har savolni baland ovozda javob berishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: how many sentences is a bio? Two: which grammatical person is it written in? Three: which win did Nilufar mention and what was its result? Four: what two fixes did the advisor give? Rehearse your answers — we check next.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: bio necha jumlada yoziladi? Ikki: bio qaysi shaxsdan yoziladi? Uch: Nilufar qaysi yutug‘ini aytdi va natijasi nima edi? To‘rt: maslahatchi qanday ikki tuzatish berdi? Javoblarni ichingizda takrorlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: bio to‘rt jumladan iborat. Ikki: uchinchi shaxs, hozirgi zamon — She is, She leads. Uch: churn modeli — ikki yuz ming dollar tejalgan. To‘rt: 'very experienced'dan 'very'ni olib tashlash va noaniq 'huge impact' o‘rniga allaqachon bor aniq raqamni yozish. To‘g‘ri javoblar shu tartibda turadi — tartibni yodda saqlang.
scenes.say: Answers. One: four sentences. Two: third person, present tense — she is, she leads. Three: Nilufar built a churn model that saved two hundred thousand dollars. Four: delete 'very', and replace the vague 'huge impact' with the concrete number.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: to‘rt jumla. Ikki: uchinchi shaxs, hozirgi zamon. Uch: churn modeli — ikki yuz ming dollar tejaldi. To‘rt: 'very' olib tashlandi va 'huge impact' o‘rniga aniq raqam qo‘yildi.

scenes.title: Professional bio: 4–6 jumla, uchinchi shaxs
scenes.say_native: Bio — konferensiya dasturi, sayt yoki taqdimot uchun yoziladi. To‘rt-olti jumla, uchinchi shaxs, hozirgi zamon. Tartibi: kimligi, kasbi, yillari; imzo yutug‘i raqam bilan; hozirgi lavozimi; bitta insoniy detal — mentorlik yoki ko‘ngilli ish. 'I' ishlatilmaydi — hammasi 'She is…', 'He has…' ko‘rinishida.
scenes.say: A professional bio is what a conference programme or website needs. Four to six sentences, third person, present tense. Order: who you are, role and years; signature win with a number; current position; one human detail. No 'I' — everything is she is, he has.
scenes.say_uz: Bio — konferensiya dasturi, sayt yoki taqdimot uchun yoziladi. To‘rt-olti jumla, uchinchi shaxs, hozirgi zamon. Tartibi: kimligi, kasbi, yillari; imzo yutug‘i raqam bilan; hozirgi lavozimi; bitta insoniy detal. 'I' ishlatilmaydi.

scenes.title: Namuna: taqdimot uchun qisqa bio
scenes.say_native: Namuna bioni tinglang. Jasur kimligini va yillarini aytadi, keyin yutug‘ini raqam bilan beradi, hozirgi ishini bayon qiladi va insoniy detal bilan yakunlaydi — dam olish kunlari talabalarga mentorlik qiladi. Bio konferensiya sahifasiga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri joylashtiriladi — o‘qib chiqib, muallifini eslab qolasiz.
scenes.say: Jasur Tokhtayev is a digital marketing executive with four years of experience in fintech. He lifted online engagement by thirty percent through data-driven content. He leads campaigns at Payme and mentors students on weekends. On weekends he mentors students preparing for product roles.
scenes.say_uz: Jasur To‘xtayev fintech sohasida to‘rt yillik tajribaga ega digital marketing ijrochisi. Ma’lumotlarga asoslangan kontent orqali jalb qilishni o‘ttiz foizga oshirgan. Payme’da kampaniyalar boshqaradi va marketing tahlili bo‘yicha mehmon ma’ruzalar o‘qiydi. Dam olish kunlari mahsulot lavozimlariga tayyorgarlik ko‘rayotgan talabalarga mentorlik qiladi.

scenes.title: Bio’ni o‘zingiz yozing
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘z biongizni to‘rt jumlada yozing. Avval kimligingiz va tajribangiz, keyin raqamli yutug‘ingiz, hozirgi ishingiz va bitta insoniy detalingiz. Har jumlani uchinchi shaxs bilan boshlang: He is…, She has…, He currently…. Ovoz chiqarib o‘qing — uchinchi shaxs dastlab noqulay, mashq bilan silliq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Write your four-sentence bio now. Who you are and your years; your quantified win; what you do now; one human detail. Start every sentence in third person: He is…, She has…. Read it aloud — third person feels odd at first, and smooths out with practice.
scenes.say_uz: Biongizni to‘rt jumlada yozing: kimligingiz va yillaringiz; raqamli yutug‘ingiz; hozirgi ishingiz; bitta insoniy detalingiz. Har jumlani uchinchi shaxs bilan boshlang: He is…, She has…. Ovoz chiqarib o‘qing — mashq bilan silliq bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Resume, CV va cover letter: farqi

examples.t: A cover letter argues fit; a resume proves it.
examples.uz: Cover letter moslikni da’vo qiladi; resume isbotlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Uch hujjatni ajrating. Resume — qisqa, marketing uslubidagi hujjat: tanlangan yutuqlar. CV — to‘liq xronologiya: barcha ishlar, nashrlar, grantlar; akademiyada majburiy. Cover letter — uch qismli xat: nima uchun shu kompaniya, nima uchun aynan siz, nima so‘rayapsiz. Resume tanishtiradi, cover letter sotadi, CV hujjatlashtiradi.
scenes.say: Keep three documents distinct. A resume is a short marketing piece — selected wins only. A CV is a full chronology: every role, publication, grant — mandatory in academia. A cover letter has three parts: why this company, why you, your ask. The resume introduces, the cover letter sells, the CV documents.
scenes.say_uz: Uch hujjatni ajrating. Resume — qisqa hujjat: tanlangan yutuqlar. CV — to‘liq xronologiya: ishlar, nashrlar, grantlar; akademiyada majburiy. Cover letter: nima uchun shu kompaniya, nima uchun aynan siz, nima so‘rayapsiz. Resume tanishtiradi, letter sotadi, CV hujjatlashtiradi.

scenes.title: LinkedIn: headline va About bo‘limi

examples.t: Headline: 'Data Analyst | Fintech | Churn to retention'.
examples.uz: Headline: 'Data Analyst | Fintech | Churn to retention'.

scenes.say_native: LinkedIn — rezyumening jonli versiyasi. Headline — ism ostidagi satr: kasbingiz, ixtisoslashuvingiz, natijangiz — Data Analyst | Fintech | Churn to retention. About’da to‘rt-olti jumla yozing, birinchi shaxs tabiiy eshitiladi. Featured’ga ikkita-uchta eng kuchli namunangizni qo‘ying va profilni haftasiga besh daqiqa yangilab turing.
scenes.say: LinkedIn is the living version of your resume. The headline under your name packs role, specialism and outcome: Data Analyst | Fintech | Churn to retention. In About write four to six sentences — first person is natural there. Put two or three strongest artefacts in Featured and maintain the profile weekly.
scenes.say_uz: LinkedIn — rezyumening jonli versiyasi. Headline — ism ostidagi satr: role, ixtisoslashuv, natija — Data Analyst | Fintech | Churn to retention. About’da to‘rt-olti jumla, birinchi shaxs tabiiy. Featured’ga eng kuchli ikkita-uchta namunangizni qo‘ying. Profilni haftalik yangilang.

scenes.title: Namuna: LinkedIn About bo‘limi
scenes.say_native: About bo‘limi namunasini tinglang. Nilufar birinchi shaxsda yozadi va beshta jumla ketma-ketligidan foydalanadi: kimligi, yutug‘i, vositalari, hozir izlayotgani va taklif bilan yakun — yozing, bog‘laning. About’da email havola ham bo‘lsin, shunda tashrif buyuruvchi bir bosishda bog‘lanadi.
scenes.say: I am a data analyst with five years in fintech, specialising in churn and retention analytics. I built a churn model that saved two hundred thousand dollars last year. My toolkit: SQL, Python, Tableau and a stakeholder-first mindset. Currently exploring senior roles where data shapes product decisions. Always happy to connect — nilufar@example.com.
scenes.say_uz: Men besh yillik tajribaga ega data analystman, churn va retention analitikasida ixtisoslashganman. O‘tgan yili ikki yuz ming dollar tejagan churn modelini qurgandman. Vositalarim: SQL, Python, Tableau. Hozir ma’lumotlar mahsulot qarorlariga ta’sir qiladigan senior rollarini qidiryapman. Bog‘lang: nilufar@example.com.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha ongidan o‘tgan 6 xato
board: 1. 'I have 4 years' → 'I bring 4 years of experience'
scenes.say_native: Oltita xato. Bir: 'I have 4 years' o‘rniga 'I bring 4 years of experience' — yoki shunchaki lavozim bilan boshlang. Ikki: 'Responsible for' o‘rniga fe’l bilan boshlang. Uch: unvonlarni so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang. To‘rt: 'etc.' inglizcha rezyumeda kam ishlatiladi. Besh: proza emas, bullet. Oltinchi: email ism.familiya shaklida bo‘lsin, taxalluslarsiz.
scenes.say: Six mindset mistakes. One: instead of 'I have 4 years', write 'I bring 4 years of experience' — or just open with the role. Two: never 'Responsible for' — lead with the verb. Three: translate titles to recognised English. Four: 'etc.' is rare in English resumes. Five: bullets, not prose. Six: email as name.surname — no nicknames.
scenes.say_uz: Oltita xato. Bir: 'I have 4 years' o‘rniga 'I bring 4 years of experience'. Ikki: 'Responsible for' emas, fe’l bilan boshlang. Uch: unvonlarni so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang. To‘rt: 'etc.' kam ishlatiladi. Besh: proza emas, bullet. Oltinchi: email ism.familiya shaklida, taxalluslarsiz.

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Uchta qatorni tuzating. 'Responsible for managing the weekly newsletter' — Managed the weekly newsletter plus raqam. 'I have 3 years experience in sales' — Sales executive with 3 years of experience. 'Promo Menedger' so‘zma-so‘z — to‘g‘risi Promotions Manager. Har birida bozor tan oladigan inglizcha shaklni qidiring.
scenes.say: Fix three lines. 'Responsible for managing the weekly newsletter' — Managed the weekly newsletter plus a number. 'I have 3 years experience in sales' — Sales executive with 3 years of experience. 'Promo Menedger' is literal — the recognised form is Promotions Manager. Reach for the market-recognised phrase.
scenes.say_uz: Uch qatorni tuzating. 'Responsible for managing the weekly newsletter' → Managed the weekly newsletter plus raqam. 'I have 3 years experience in sales' → Sales executive with 3 years of experience. 'Promo Menedger' → Promotions Manager. Bozor tan oladigan shaklni qidiring.

scenes.title: CVni jo‘natish: fayl nomi, format, kuzatuv

examples.t: Subject: Application — Data Analyst — Job ID 1234.
examples.uz: Mavzu: Application — Data Analyst — Job ID 1234.

scenes.say_native: So‘nggi qadam. Fayl nomi professional bo‘lsin: Ism_Familiya_CV.pdf — 'resume final FINAL 2(3).pdf' emas. Faqat PDF yuboring. Email mavzusi aniq bo‘lsin: Application — Sales Manager — Job ID 1234. Xat ikki qator: ariza, rezyume ilova qilingan, suhbatga tayyorman. Bir hafta jimlikdan keyin bitta muloyim follow-up yozing.
scenes.say: The last mile. File name professional: Firstname_Lastname_CV.pdf — never 'resume final FINAL 2(3).pdf'. Send PDF only. Subject precise: Application — Sales Manager — Job ID 1234. Two-line body: applying for the role, CV attached. One polite follow-up after a week of silence.
scenes.say_uz: So‘nggi qadam. Fayl nomi: Ism_Familiya_CV.pdf — 'resume final FINAL 2(3).pdf' emas. Faqat PDF. Mavzu aniq: Application — Sales Manager — Job ID 1234. Xat ikki qator: ariza, rezyume ilova qilingan. Bir hafta jimlikdan keyin bitta muloyim follow-up.

scenes.title: Motivatsion mashq: 5 achievement line
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasiga tayyorgarlik. O‘zingizning besh achievement line’ingizni yozing. Har birida uch element: harakat fe’li, vazifa, raqamli natija. Beshtasini ketma-ket yozing, keyin har birini ovoz chiqarib ikki marta o‘qib, eng sust qatorni qayta yozing. Uy vazifasida aynan shu besh qator asosiy natijangiz bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Homework rehearsal. Write five achievement lines of your own. Each needs three elements: an action verb, a task, a quantified result. Write five in a row, read each aloud twice, rewrite the weakest. These five are the core deliverable of your homework.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasiga tayyorgarlik. O‘zingizning besh achievement line’ingizni yozing: harakat fe’li, vazifa, raqamli natija. Beshtasini yozing, har birini ikki marta ovoz chiqarib o‘qib, eng sust qatorni qayta yozing. Uy vazifasida aynan shu besh qator asosiy natijangiz bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
board: CV bo‘limlari: summary → experience → education → skills
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Rezyume besh bo‘limdan iborat: contact, summary, experience, education, skills. Summary uch jumla bo‘lsin va lavozimdan boshlansin. Har achievement qatori action verb va kamida bitta raqam ishlatsin. Sanalar va lavozim nomlarida bir format saqlansin. ATS uchun e’lon kalit so‘zlari tabiiy tarqalsin. Bio — to‘rt-olti jumla, uchinchi shaxs.
scenes.say: Sum up. Five sections: contact, summary, experience, education, skills. Three-sentence summary opening with the role. Every bullet opens with an action verb and carries a number. Dates and titles keep one format. ATS keywords spread naturally. A bio runs four to six sentences, third person.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Besh bo‘lim: contact, summary, experience, education, skills. Summary uch jumla, lavozimdan boshlansin. Har bullet action verb va raqam ishlatsin. Sanalar va unvonlar bir formatda. E’lon kalit so‘zlari CV’ga tabiiy tarqalsin. Bio to‘rt-olti jumla, uchinchi shaxs.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Bitta ish e’loniga mos CV versiyasi
Keyingi dars: Ish joyida hamkasblar bilan muloqot
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: uch jumlalik CV summary’ingizni va beshta achievement line yozing — har birida action verb va raqam bo‘lsin. Bitta haqiqiy ish e’lonini topib, unga mos rezyume versiyasini tayyorlang va ATS kalit so‘zlari bo‘yicha tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ish joyidagi muloqotni o‘rganamiz — small talk’dan muloyim norozilik bildirishgacha. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: write your three-sentence summary and five achievement lines — action verb plus number each. Find one real job ad, tailor a CV version to it, and check it against the ad's ATS keywords. Next lesson: communicating with colleagues at work — from small talk to polite disagreement. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: uch jumlalik summary’ingizni va beshta achievement line yozing — action verb va raqam bilan. Bitta haqiqiy ish e’lonini topib, unga mos rezyume versiyasini tayyorlang va ATS kalit so‘zlariga tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ish joyidagi muloqotni o‘rganamiz. Omad tilayman!

quiz.q: How many sentences should a profile summary ideally contain?
quiz.why_uz: Uch jumla yetarli: kimligingiz, raqamli yutug‘ingiz va nima taklif qilishingiz — HR ko‘proq o‘qishga undaydigan hajm.

quiz.q: Which is the strongest opening for an achievement bullet?
quiz.why_uz: Qator harakat fe’li bilan boshlansin — 'Responsible for' va 'duties included' vazifani tasvirlaydi, yutuqni emas.
ATS — Applicant Tracking System; rezyumeni kalit so‘zlar bo‘yicha skanerlab saralaydi, shuning uchun e’lon so‘zlarini CV'da ishlatish kerak.

quiz.q: Which date format is acceptable and uniform?
options: '2022/03' for some jobs and 'Mar 22' for others
quiz.why_uz: Bitta hujjatda format bir xil bo‘lsin: hamma joylarda 'March 2022 – Present' yoki barchasida raqamli format — aralashtirish professional emas.

quiz.q: What should you do with a gap in your employment history?
options: Write one honest line explaining it and show what you did
Invent a job from that period
quiz.why_uz: Halol bir qator — career break sababi va o‘sha davrdagi kurs yoki loyiha — ishonchni oshiradi; yashirish yoki to‘qish fosh bo‘ladi.

quiz.q: How should a professional bio be written?
options: As a bullet list of duties
quiz.why_uz: Bio uchinchi shaxs, hozirgi zamon va to‘rt-olti jumlada yoziladi: kimligi, raqamli yutug‘i, hozirgi ishi va bitta insoniy detal.

quiz.q: What is the best way to name your CV file?
quiz.why_uz: Ism_Familiya_CV.pdf — HR qidiruvda oson topadi va professional ko‘rinadi; PDF formatni saqlaydi.

quiz.q: Which of these does NOT belong on an English-language resume?
quiz.why_uz: Inglizcha rezyumeda yosh, oilaviy holat va foto so‘ralmaydi; faqat aloqa, yutuqlar va ko‘nikmalar kerak.

quiz.q: What is the purpose of a cover letter?
options: To repeat the CV word for word
To argue fit: why this company, why you, your ask
To list every job you have ever had
quiz.why_uz: Cover letter uch qismdan iborat: nega shu kompaniya, nega aynan siz va nima so‘rayapsiz — CV'ni takrorlamasligi kerak.

quiz.q: Where should ATS keywords from a job ad go in your CV?
options: Only in a hidden white-text block
Spread naturally across summary, skills and experience
quiz.why_uz: Kalit so‘zlarni summary, skills va experience qismlariga tabiiy tarqating; yashirin yoki sun’iy to‘ldirish ATS'da ham, HR'da ham xavfli.
